title: SPARC: SuperPixel-Aware Region Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Dense Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.25067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become an effective approach for learning visual representations without manual annotations. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has been widely used for visual representation learning. However, existing contrastive SSL methods have focused primarily on image-level or pixel-level representation learning, while region-level representation learning remains less explored. We propose SPARC, a region-level contrastive learning framework that leverages superpixels to establish explicit correspondence between augmented image views. SPARC introduces a region contrastive branch that performs superpixel-based feature pooling and optimizes a region-level contrastive objective jointly with a global image-level objective. translated_title: SPARC：面向自监督密集预测的超像素感知区域对比学习
translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）已成为无需人工标注即可学习视觉表示的有效方法。在SSL方法中，对比学习已被广泛应用于视觉表示学习。然而，现有的对比式SSL方法主要集中于图像级或像素级的表示学习，而区域级的表示学习仍然较少被探索。我们提出了SPARC，这是一个区域级对比学习框架，它利用超像素在增强的图像视图之间建立显式对应关系。SPARC引入了一个区域对比分支，该分支执行基于超像素的特征池化，并将区域级对比目标与全局图像级目标进行联合优化。在相同设置下，SPARC始终优于MoCo-v2和DenseCL等先前方法，在语义分割任务上实现了高达+9.79 mIoU的提升，以及+4.88 AP的提升（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SPARC提出了一种利用超像素在增强视图间建立显式对应的区域级对比学习框架，在语义分割等密集预测任务上显著超越了MoCo-v2和DenseCL等现有方法。
en_tdlr: SPARC is a region-level contrastive learning framework that leverages superpixels to establish explicit correspondence between augmented views, consistently outperforming MoCo-v2 and DenseCL on dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation.
